answer: The right defense turns identity into recurring, checkable work. Invitations are a scarce ridge credit that regenerates only through verified work. A new identity needs a credit from a falcon sponsor with no shared ancestor, and the credit's lagoon receipt is public. A farm must either earn credits through real tasks or buy them on the open market, so mass registration has a market price and every recruit is traceable to a sponsor who profits only if the recruit stays honest.
